title: An agent records a person's approval as that person's human label, through a delegation they grant
description: Ryan (2026-10-18): tell a research agent in a live session that a Reference is approved and have the cyclotron treat it as his label. Design: the person creates a short-lived, scoped, revocable delegation in the Newsroom (signed in); the agent passes the token with papyrus references approve/reject --on-behalf-of. The curation Lambda verifies it and records actorKind human, attestation delegated, relayedBy agent, delegationId. Agent judgment alone never counts. Needs: Delegation model + schema, create/revoke mutation (human sign-in only), Lambda verification, CLI commands, UI to create and revoke (Mac), docs in story-reporting.md (written, marked not yet available).
